contract.application_relevance: A Worker can retain a local query view while replacing a redirect URL within one synchronous request.
contract.candidate_classification: assertion-bearing ordinary API correctness candidate; no reviewed census credit yet
contract.cleanup: All URL, params, iterator, pattern, array, and result values are request-local. Return from synchronous fetch releases references. No timer, outgoing fetch, binding, durable write, object URL allocation, or retained cross-request capability. External supervisor stops only owned processes and deletes only its fresh deployment/store directory after receipt capture.
contract.desired_behavior: The original view remains the same object bound to the new URL, and the iterator retains its index over the updated list.
contract.distinctness: Whole-URL replacement rebinding; U214 instead mutates an independent params list through its own API.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.deep(cursor.next(), { value: ['old', '1'], done: false }, 'consume one item before href replacement');
t.equal(url.searchParams === live, true, 'href replacement preserves query object identity');
t.deep(cursor.next(), { value: ['second', 'b'], done: false }, 'existing iterator keeps index in replaced list');
t.equal(url.href, 'https://after.example.test:8443/new?first=a&second=b&last=c#next', 'existing query object stays bound to replacement URL');
t.deep(cursor.next(), { value: ['last', 'c'], done: false }, 'preexisting iterator sees later append');
contract.hypothesis: Replacing href may detach a previously obtained searchParams object or leave an existing iterator reading the old list.
contract.mechanism: URL href replacement and same-object query-list rebinding
contract.ordinary_input_scope: Successful public API calls on complete ordinary URL strings or valid property, pair, and pattern inputs. Valid URL nonmatches are intentional boolean/null outcomes, never malformed-input probes. Example domains and documentation IPv6 addresses are data only.
preconditions: Fresh isolated fixture deployment on the exact reviewed direct-celld build; external source/build/process witness required.
Global URL, URLSearchParams, and for U217-U220 URLPattern are supplied by celld, not by Node, a shim, or a mock.
External finite-deadline supervisor and owned-process cleanup are available; missing runtime prerequisites are BLOCKED.

runtime_operations: Construct URL and save its query view and entries iterator.

Assert query object identity, replacement tuples, and the next existing-iterator tuple.
Append through the old view, assert new href and iterator tail, then exhaustion.
